results.content: Sister Jacqueline Verville, CSC (Sister Mary Colombe of Portugal), 90, of Manchester, died August 23, 2026. She entered the Congregation of the Sisters of Holy Cross in 1955 and pronounced her final vows in 1962. After teaching in New England schools as well as Notre Dame College in Manchester, she founded in 2010 the Holy Cross Family Learning Center on Manchester’s West Side. For eight years, she administered a program for immigrants and refugees.
